caption:
Mr Turtle goes barefoot on tiles at home and walks hard footpaths to work. Lately the middle of his heel aches.

Under your heel there's a fat pad that works like a natural cushion. If it thins, you may feel impact more on hard surfaces.

Hybi's tip: wear cushioned slippers at home, consider a heel cup in your shoes, and stand on a soft mat if you're on your feet a while. Build your walking up bit by bit.

A swollen or red heel, numbness in your foot, or pain that isn't settling are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 👣
